content.short: RSS3 is an information dissemination protocol for Web3 centered on feeds and search.
content.description: RSS3 is an open protocol that aims to decentralize content, social networks, and other feeds in Web 3.0, making them accessible to everyone. It gives users full control over their data and the option to monetize it in line with their preferences. The platform enables developers and users to create third-party applications with a simple user interface running on distributed nodes, which can power desktop apps, mobile apps, and browser extensions. By providing a shared, interoperable foundation, RSS3 supports a range of decentralized services that connect creators, communities, and audiences without relying on centralized intermediaries.
